title: About CHUWU

seo.description: CHUWU (初·五) creates fragrance guided by Bazi and the Five Elements.

intro: Fragrance, tuned to your elemental balance.
body:
CHUWU (初·五) began with a simple idea: the scent you wear can help bring you back into balance.

In Chinese metaphysics, every birth chart carries the Five Elements — **Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water** (五行) — in different amounts. Most of us have more of some and less of others. CHUWU reads your Bazi (八字) to find what your chart is missing, then translates it into fragrance: notes chosen for the element you need most.

## Our signature blends

Alongside personalised blends, our five signature scents are each composed for one intention — love, wealth, career, health and overall balance — so there is a CHUWU for every moment, reading or not.
